scripts.jenkins-config-template: npx psl render config/$NODE_ENV.json.template --fromrole true > config/$NODE_ENV.json
scripts.load-secrets-dev: npx psl render config/develop.json.template --profile develop > config/develop.json
scripts.load-secrets-stg: npx psl render config/stage.json.template --profile stage > config/stage.json
scripts.report:allure: npm run allure:generate && npm run allure:open
scripts.skill:pack: cp skills/swagger-api-gen/SKILL.md .claude/skills/swagger-api-gen/SKILL.md; rm -rf /tmp/_skill_pack && mkdir /tmp/_skill_pack && cp skills/swagger-api-gen/SKILL.md skills/swagger-api-gen/config.json /tmp/_skill_pack/ && cd /tmp/_skill_pack && zip -j swagger-api-gen.skill SKILL.md config.json && cp swagger-api-gen.skill $OLDPWD/swagger-api-gen.skill && echo 'Packaged → swagger-api-gen.skill'
scripts.skill:pack:audit: rm -rf /tmp/_skill_pack_audit && mkdir /tmp/_skill_pack_audit && cp skills/api-spec-audit/SKILL.md skills/api-spec-audit/config.json /tmp/_skill_pack_audit/ && cd /tmp/_skill_pack_audit && zip -j api-spec-audit.skill SKILL.md config.json && cp api-spec-audit.skill $OLDPWD/api-spec-audit.skill && echo 'Packaged → api-spec-audit.skill'
scripts.skill:pack:all: npm run skill:pack && npm run skill:pack:audit && echo 'Done — drag both .skill files into Cowork and click Save skill on each.'
